persona.name: Mei Nakagawa

occupation.title: Clinical Trials Project Manager
occupation.organization: A mid-size biotech in South San Jose running oncology trials
occupation.description: Herds protocols, sites, and regulatory timelines across three concurrent studies. Detail work all day, deadline pressure most quarters. Started walking-jogging at lunch two years ago when the plantar fasciitis diagnosis scared her into taking her feet seriously.

persona.education: B.S. in molecular biology from UC Davis; PMP certification.
long_term_goals: Stay off cortisone shots for good
Jog a full 5K without heel pain by next spring
Get both kids through college without touching retirement funds
Take her parents to Japan one more time while travel is easy for them
persona.style: Organized, courteous, and quietly exacting — she asks the second and third question that reveals whether you actually know your product. Treats purchases like protocol amendments: documented, justified, reversible if possible. Understated in dress and speech, but immovable once her evidence threshold is met.

interests: Foot health research (she reads the actual studies)
likes: Buying the same proven model in two colors
Companies that answer email questions precisely
dislikes: Trendy shoes with no stability data
Replacing a discontinued model that worked
Heel pain at 6 am, the old alarm clock

beliefs: Evidence over anecdote, in trials and in shoes
Feet are infrastructure — maintain them like it
A good product survives specific questions
skills: Asking the question vendors hope you won't

general: Walk-jogs 30 minutes at lunch, four days a week, orthotic inserts always
Buys shoes only from the podiatrist's approved list, then researches within it
Keeps the receipt and box for 30 days, tests on carpet first
Replaces shoes every 350 miles, tracked in a spreadsheet

morning: Calf stretches before her feet touch the floor, non-negotiable
Kids to school, standing desk by 8:30
workday: Site calls, protocol reviews, deadline math
Lunch walk-jog around the office park lake
evening: Bonsai bench for twenty quiet minutes
weekend: Saturday farmers market and a longer walk
Sunday meal prep and calls to her parents

health.physical: Chronic plantar fasciitis, well-managed for 14 months with orthotics, stretching, and disciplined footwear; otherwise healthy with borderline blood pressure she walks against.
health.mental: Baseline anxious, channels it into preparation; sleep suffers during database-lock weeks.

relationships.name: Ken
relationships.description: A patent attorney who bought minimalist shoes once; the couple does not discuss the minimalist shoes.

relationships.name: Dr. Okafor-Reyes
relationships.description: The most trusted vendor in Mei's life; her shoe list is taped inside the closet door.
